premise: A shy girl at a magic academy who is the reincarnation of the greatest mage in history, but she doesn't know it yet.

draft.premise: A shy girl at a magic academy who is the reincarnation of the greatest mage in history, but she doesn't know it yet.

world.title: Echo of the Archmage
world.era: A Victorian-style magical era with gas lamps, steam trains, and parchment scrolls.

extraordinary.reach: Mages can conjure elements, ward off curses, and manipulate physical laws, though creating life remains impossible.

rules.text: Magic requires a physical catalyst like a wand, staff, or focus ring to channel safely.
The soul can reincarnate across centuries, carrying its original magical blueprint, though memories are sealed at birth.
Oakhaven Academy is a sovereign sanctuary where external kingdom laws do not apply.

peoples.name: Humans
peoples.culture: A society deeply divided by bloodlines and magical aptitude.

creatures.name: Mana Sprite
creatures.description: Small glowing embers of pure magical energy that feed on ambient spells.
creatures.worth: Can be harvested for liquid mana stabilizer.

nature: Magic flows in underground ley lines, making certain geographic points highly conductive to spellcraft.

rungs.name: 1st Circle
rungs.description: Novices who can light candles or lift feathers.

rungs.name: 2nd Circle
rungs.description: Apprentices learning to shape elemental shields and standard charms.

rungs.name: 3rd Circle
rungs.description: Adepts capable of casting complex combat spells and wards.

rungs.name: 4th Circle
rungs.description: Mages recognized as fully independent magic practitioners.

rungs.name: 5th Circle
rungs.description: Scholar-Mages who command high elements and specialize in research.

rungs.name: 6th Circle
rungs.description: High Mages who serve as battle commanders or court advisors.

rungs.name: 7th Circle
rungs.description: Master Mages, the peak of modern magical society.

rungs.name: 8th Circle
rungs.description: Grandmasters, legendary figures who can reshape landscapes.

rungs.name: 9th Circle
rungs.description: Archmage, a mythic state where one becomes a living conduit of magic.

travel.description: Scholars and nobles travel by steam-powered trains or enchanted carriages. Messages are sent via messenger owls or magic mirrors.

medicine.healing: Potions and restorative spells can mend bone and skin in hours, but complex organ damage requires intensive surgery.

laws.text: Magic duels must be overseen by a licensed academic arbiter.

places.name: Oakhaven Academy Grounds
places.description: An sprawling gothic campus surrounded by high iron gates and misty ancient forests.

places.name: The Hearthside Dormitories
places.description: A cozy, stone-walled dormitory complex smelling of cedarwood and old tea.

places.name: The Grand Library of Oakhaven
places.description: Countless floors of towering mahogany bookshelves that stretch into the vaulted ceilings.

places.name: The Whispering Woods
places.description: An ancient, forbidden forest bordering the academy where wild magical beasts roam.

factions.name: Oakhaven Faculty Council
factions.description: The senior scholars and masters who manage the curriculum and safety of the academy.
factions.goal: To preserve the secrets of ancient magic while molding the next generation of wizards.
factions.methods: Strict educational discipline and rigorous testing.
factions.strength: Dozens of high-level battle mages and centuries of defensive runes.
secrets: They suspect an Archmage soul has returned to the academy.

factions.name: The Ecliptic Order
factions.description: A secretive cabal operating outside the kingdoms, searching for relics of the ancient mages.
factions.goal: To find and forcibly awaken the reincarnation of Valerius the Great to use his magic for world domination.
factions.methods: Infiltration, espionage, and forbidden soul-tracking spells.
factions.strength: Wealthy patrons and rogue dark mages.
secrets: They have a spy among the academy students.

npcs.name: Headmaster Alastair Vance
npcs.description: A kind but watchful old wizard with a sweeping silver beard and eyes that seem to read minds.
npcs.appearance: Tall, dressed in elaborate gold-stitched velvet robes, carrying a gnarled elderwood staff.

wants: to protect the world from unstable high-tier spells

agenda.goal: Quietly monitor Sylvia Mercer to see if her latent mana matches the ancient records.
agenda.method: Assigning her subtle reading tasks and tracking her growth.
agenda.secret: He suspects her true identity but fears telling her will shatter her fragile mind.

secrets: He knows Valerius's final resting place is sealed beneath the library.

npcs.name: Evelyn Vance
npcs.description: An arrogant and highly talented noble girl who believes she is destined to be the top scholar of her year.
npcs.appearance: Sharp facial features, long golden ringlets, wearing a tailored silk academy uniform with a ruby brooch.

wants: to be the undisputed star of Oakhaven Academy

clocks.name: The Midterm Spellcraft Exhibition
steps: Students draft their spell demonstrations under teacher supervision.
The theoretical exams begin in the Grand Library.
The practical magic arena is opened for live spell-weaving tests.

threads.title: Passing the Midterm Exhibition
threads.stakes: Failing the midterms means being placed in remedial classes or losing academy housing.

threads.title: Echoes of the Forgotten Archmage
threads.stakes: Discovering why Sylvia can read languages she was never taught and why ancient spells bend to her command.

mysteries.question: Why do the ancient texts of Archmage Valerius feel so familiar?
mysteries.answer: Sylvia is the direct reincarnation of Archmage Valerius. He sealed his soul centuries ago to escape a cosmic soul-devouring curse, leaving his memories to slowly drip-feed into his next incarnation once her mana matured.
clues: Sylvia can effortlessly read the encrypted Valerian cipher without a translation key.
She experiences reoccurring dreams of a burning black tower and an obsidian staff.
Her mana signature perfectly resonates with the ancient wards protecting the academy library.

known_facts: Oakhaven Academy is the premier magic institution on the continent.
Archmage Valerius was the legendary figure who ended the Great Rift War 500 years ago.
The midterm exhibition requires a successful display of elemental magic.

opening.situation: The morning sun filters through the stained-glass window of your dormitory room, illuminating a towering stack of spellbooks you must memorize before your first exam.

world.summary: Sylvia Mercer is a quiet, unassuming student struggling to stay afloat in the prestigious Oakhaven Academy. Unbeknownst to her and the world, her fragile soul is the vessel for the reincarnation of Valerius, the greatest archmage in mortal history.

character.name: Sylvia Mercer
character.description: A quiet, fragile-looking girl who flinches when spoken to, keeping her eyes glued to her boots.
character.appearance: Slim build, shoulder-length unruly brown hair, large hazel eyes. She wears an oversized, slightly faded Oakhaven uniform that dwarfs her frame.

skills.name: theory-of-magic
skills.notes: Excellent reading retention, though shy to speak up in class.

traits.name: Socially Shy
traits.description: Sylvia struggles with public speaking and panics under direct pressure from authority figures.

traits.name: Meticulous Note-taker
traits.description: Writes small, incredibly detailed margins on margins, keeping a very clean record of magical formulas.

talents.name: Echo of the Archmage
talents.covers: any spellcraft or ancient magical script she studies
talents.reason: Her soul carries the dormant memories of the greatest mage in history, making complex magical theorems feel like remembering an old habit.

powers.name: Latent Primordial Mana
limits: Currently locked by a soul seal, only triggering when her life is in mortal peril.
Casting at this level without a sturdy catalyst will severely burn her hands.

costs.text: Requires days of bed rest to recover from a single high-tier manifestation.

wants: to pass her midterms quietly and blend into the background
temperament.voice: Soft, hesitant, and prone to whispering.

items.name: standard-issue copper wand
items.description: A basic magic focus tailored for beginner students.

items.name: Elementary Spellbook
items.description: Thick leather-bound book containing standard 1st Circle and 2nd Circle incantations.

character.title: Novice Scholar
backstory: Raised in a quiet rural village, Sylvia was sent to the prestigious Oakhaven Academy after she accidentally lit her family's well on fire during a sudden panic.
She has spent her first month at school terrified of being sent home, constantly hiding behind her massive textbooks.
hidden_past: She was once Archmage Valerius, who saved the mortal world five centuries ago before sealing his own soul to hide from a powerful cosmic entity that sought to devour his power.
